_comment: Repo-owned 301 map for retired content URLs. Emitted into dist/_redirects by
Unlike the industries redirects, the `from` paths here DO still resolve to a static
file in dist/. That is deliberate and it works: Cloudflare Pages applies _redirects
'regardless of whether or not an asset matches the incoming request'
Blog bodies are Supabase-authoritative (see tools/publish-blog-ci.mjs), so a blog post
cannot be retired by deleting it from the repo. Redirecting it is the only durable
mechanism, and the five comparison slugs below are additionally pinned against removal
by PROTECTED_COMPARISON_SLUGS in that same file.
